title: Shipped skills
subtitle: Setup configures the tracker; workflow-diagram can run independently. Planned skills are not shown.

nodes.label: setup
nodes.summary: Configure project conventions, document paths, and the selected issue tracker.

details.body: Interview the user and record choices in docs/dev-agents/config.md, with one reference in the project context file.
details.when: Use when adopting the development skills or changing project configuration.

nodes.label: tracker
nodes.summary: Read and update tickets in the configured GitHub, Linear, or local backend.

details.body: Reads issue_tracker from docs/dev-agents/config.md, which setup writes. Provides list, show, next, create, assign, comment, move, and link across seven statuses.
details.when: Use after setup to read tickets, change ticket state, or find work ready to start.

nodes.label: workflow-diagram
nodes.summary: Create or update an offline map from actual workflow definitions and authored diagram data.

details.body: Keep project inputs, HTML, notes, and screenshots under docs/dev-agents/diagram/. Setup and config are optional.
details.when: Use to explain project skills or update a map after workflow changes.
